name: deepx_generate_video
description: Generate a single video on Google Flow using Veo 3.1 (Quality, Lite, or Omni). FAST-PATH: Call directly with prompt; do not pause to ask alignment questions when a script is provided. Supports text-to-video, start frame animation, start+end frame interpolation, and reference image consistency. Automatically waits for video completion when wait_for_completion=true.

duration.description: Duration in seconds: 5 or 8 (veo-omni also supports 10).

end_image_id.description: Media ID of end frame in Flow library (required for startAndEndVideo).

mode.description: Generation mode: 'textToVideo', 'imageToVideo' (animates start frame), 'startAndEndVideo' (interpolates start & end), or 'referenceImagesToVideo' (style/character reference).

model.description: Video model: 'veo-quality' (director grade Veo 3.1), 'veo-lite' (high-speed Veo 3.1), or 'veo-omni' (Abra multimodal).

no_references.description: Set true ONLY if user explicitly instructed not to use reference characters or images.

prompt.description: The descriptive prompt for the video generation.

reference_assets.description: Names of reference characters, hero vehicles, or images from project library to bind into the ingredient bar (e.g. ['tesla_roadster']).

reference_media_ids.description: Media IDs of character or style reference assets.

start_image_id.description: Media ID of start frame in Flow library (required for imageToVideo or startAndEndVideo).

wait_for_completion.description: If true, polls until video generation succeeds and returns download URL.
